metadata.description: Canada VC investment by stage, annual (CVCA). CAD millions.
metadata.primary_source: CVCA Year-End 2024, CVCA Q1-2025, BDC Canada VC Landscape 2025

stage_definitions.pre_seed: CVCA Pre-seed stage (typically <$1M–$2M deal size, pre-product)
stage_definitions.early: CVCA Early Stage — primarily Series A & B
stage_definitions.later: CVCA Later Stage — primarily Series C & D
stage_definitions.growth: CVCA Growth Equity — Series E and beyond

metadata.notes: 2023 stage values partly estimated by back-applying BDC Figure 10 YoY % changes to 2024 CVCA actuals. 2024 pre-seed/seed/later confirmed directly from CVCA text. 2024 growth equity: $1.5B including Clio $1.24B (84% of growth total). Ex-Clio growth equity 2024 = ~$247M.

pre_seed.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 direct: 'Pre-seed funding totaled $161M across 120 deals'

seed.source: Derived: BDC states Seed 2024 YoY = -45%, so 2023 = $510M/0.55 = $927M. CVCA chart appears to show similar level to 2021 ($958M) — close.

early.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 chart. BDC derived (−8% from $3,026M 2024... wait: CVCA 2024 early = $2,930M → 2023 = $2,930/0.92 = $3,185M). CVCA chart direct read = $3,155M.

later.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 direct: 'Later-stage companies secured $2.1B across 52 deals in 2024'... 2023 from chart = $2,184M, 58 deals

growth.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 + BDC: '$91M across 3 deals in 2023'

pre_seed.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 direct: '$99M across 115 deals, 19% of deal volume, 1% of dollars'

seed.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 direct: '$510M across 201 deals, down 47% in value YoY'

early.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 direct: '$2.9B across 166 deals, 37% of all VC investment'

later.source: CVCA Year-End 2024 direct: '$2.1B across 52 deals, 27% of total value'

growth.source: BDC direct: '$1.5B across 8 deals; Clio's Series F accounted for 84% ($1.24B)'. CVCA Year-End shows ~$1.5B. Revised CVCA Q1-2025 chart shows $537M — discrepancy may reflect reclassification of Clio deal.
